scope_statement: Read-only ownership, source-rights, market-definition, clock, history, identity, contract, validation, and downstream-boundary readiness. No external source access or implementation.

bucky_identity_evidence.evidence_role: canonical identity pin only; not market evidence

collision_check.finding: No open pull request or branch collided with the two issue-235 audit paths at branch creation.

authorized: accept TIBER-Data as the proposed D0 source-truth owner
inspect already-committed TIBER-Fantasy PR 304 artifacts as prototype evidence only
design the readiness contract and failure behavior
publish paired audit documents to a draft pull request
prohibited: external source access or live API calls
scraping, credentials, subscription, purchase, or license acceptance
download, retention, mirroring, backfill, adapter, scheduler, database, or snapshot generation
consensus construction, strategy interpretation, ranking, advice, UI, or downstream activation

ownership.rationale: A dated source-specific market observation is an external fact with identity, provenance, rights, clocks, missingness, validation, and immutable-history requirements.

boundaries.TIBER-Data: source admission, exact market contract, provider identity, clocks, immutable snapshots, validation, and any later promotion
boundaries.TIBER-Strategy: market interpretation, Board Geometry, tier and cohort policy
boundaries.TIBER-Research: bounded empirical work consuming admitted snapshots
boundaries.TIBER-Ops/operator: source-rights admission, activation, promotion, and downstream authority

source_rights_matrix.product: API v1 ADP endpoint; exact source-native product name and documentation reference not preserved
source_rights_matrix.evidence_mode: already-committed TIBER-Fantasy PR 304 prototype only; endpoint was not called by this audit
source_rights_matrix.observed_access_method: prototype code performs an unauthenticated HTTP GET
source_rights_matrix.metric_definition: response field is named adp, but aggregation method and exact semantic definition are unverified
source_rights_matrix.source_population: unverified; managed redraft, mock, best-ball, contest, and other population distinctions are not established
source_rights_matrix.source_identifiers: provider player_id present; no governed FFC-to-GSIS bridge
source_rights_matrix.history: three unique same-day prototype snapshots; no lawful trailing-12-month lane established
source_rights_matrix.cadence: source publication cadence unknown; README's intended daily retrieval is a TIBER proposal, not source schedule evidence
blockers: source documentation and metric semantics not pinned
terms for automated access, retention, exact-value storage, display, and redistribution not reviewed
market population and draft type unknown

first_source_finding.finding: The FFC lane is the only source-shaped prototype inspected, but it is not eligible for activation or admission.
first_source_finding.reason: Rights, metric definition, population, draft type, source clocks, history, and canonical identity remain unresolved.
first_source_finding.smallest_required_followup: A separately authorized source-and-rights review must bind one exact provider product and document its terms, definitions, population, IDs, clocks, cadence, history, immutable-reference support, and operator-approved use envelope before any adapter activation.

prototype_inventory.latest_alias_behavior: Each latest file has the same blob as its corresponding dated file at the inspected commit. The script overwrites latest aliases, so only dated immutable objects could be eligible in a future lane.
prototype_inventory.evidence_limit: Prototype presence proves three persisted retrievals on one retrieval date and a candidate vocabulary only; it does not prove source admission, historical continuity, source cadence, or current truth.

market_measure_registry.rule: May populate a governed ADP value only after the source defines the calculation and draft population. A field label alone is insufficient.
Separate measure ID; never relabel as ADP unless the source explicitly defines its ADP that way.
Source-specific product whose components and method remain disclosed; not TIBER consensus and not 'the market'.
Out of scope and unavailable without a separately approved versioned methodology.

candidate_contract_sketch.snapshot_grain: one source product x one exact market configuration x one NFL season x one source calculation window x one source/as-of time
invariants: one row belongs to exactly one immutable snapshot
null or unknown never becomes a plausible default
provider rank, expert rank, median pick, and ADP never share an ambiguous field
every value remains source-product and configuration specific
unresolved identity remains visible and name-only fallback is forbidden
corrections append and supersede; they never overwrite prior dated snapshots

identity.provider_id_rule: Provider IDs remain source-specific and require an exact source-backed bridge.
identity.names_teams_positions_rule: Display and audit context only; never join authority.

adjacent_work.relevance: Sleeper-to-GSIS only; does not solve FFC identity
normalized-name candidate proposal is not governed join authority and is not authorized here

identity.duplicate_conflict_behavior: Duplicate provider IDs, provider-ID reuse, conflicting GSIS edges, or unresolved mappings fail closed or require explicit operator review.

rules: retrieval time never substitutes for source as-of or source-available time
repository commit time is provenance, not a market clock
a source window end date is not automatically a source as-of timestamp
future-dated or stale snapshots are ineligible for a cutoff
clocks.prototype_gap: Only calculation-window dates and retrieval time are present; source as-of, generation, availability, and revision clocks are missing.

current_selector.expression: latest eligible immutable source snapshot on or before the claim cutoff for the exact requested source product and market configuration
eligibility_requires: source as-of at or before cutoff
current_selector.tie_break: source revision order if documented, then immutable snapshot_id lexical order; unresolved same-clock conflicts remain unavailable

rules: preserve each admitted immutable snapshot independently
same source product and exact market configuration only
no source splicing, forward fill, interpolation, or invented historical as-of
return partial when lawful comparable observations cover only part of the window
disclose expected and observed cadence gaps
trailing_12_month_history.prototype_coverage: one retrieval date with three unique configurations; no trailing-12-month history

cadence_and_supersession.cadence_finding: No exact cadence can be adopted because no source is admitted and the source publication schedule is unknown. PR 304's intended daily retrieval is not source-cadence evidence.
cadence_and_supersession.supersession_rule: append-only with supersedes_snapshot_id, reason, correction_observed_at, corrected source revision, and changed-field summary

rules: keep every platform, product, configuration, and clock in a separate lane
never average incompatible sources or configurations
preserve and disclose provider-consensus composition when available
show material disagreement; do not select the most favorable number
a future TIBER consensus requires separate methodology and operator approval

peer_selector.selection: three eligible same-position rows immediately above and three immediately below the anchor by numeric governed ADP
peer_selector.failure_behavior: unavailable if the anchor identity or governed measure is unresolved; partial only when an otherwise eligible snapshot has fewer than three valid peers on a side, with exclusions disclosed

bucky_golden_trace.requested_market: 2026 full-PPR redraft, exact source-supported team count and draft type
required_future_outputs: nearest comparable prior-year observation if present
bucky_golden_trace.interpretation_boundary: The Data trace can report observations and missingness; it cannot label a dip, value, buy, or opportunity.

proposed_future_paths.note: Path adoption, implementation, execution, and promotion each require later explicit authority and repository-convention review.

source_admission_does_not_authorize: Strategy interpretation or Board Geometry changes
